## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm test` pass (and `cd server && npm run typecheck && npm test` for backend changes)
- [ ] The simulation stays deterministic (no randomness, wall-clock time or iteration-order dependence in the tick path)
- [ ] Docs updated (`ARCHITECTURE.md`, `docs/`, `README`) if behaviour or a protocol changed
- [ ] No names, art, layouts or measurements taken from other games
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
